decisions.reason: The About-page process copy must remove Big Block references, but the existing Event also reintroduces previously removed Aave copy and regresses automatic prize delivery without support from this source.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hey [FREELANCER_NAME_001], I’d like to remove the big blocks and redirect that extra $1 to me, making the split:
$15 buy, $5 to me, $5 to affiliate, $5 to block prize pool.

This improves my bottom line while having minimal effect on sales.
It also makes the game mechanics and marketing simpler.

An even split between me and every community member, together with everyone having an equal chance at the never-ending $500 prizes, seems consistent with the project’s ethos.

process_items.label: Mint the ebook NFT
process_items.copy: Buy your ebook NFT for $15 USD. The mint number you receive becomes your referral code.

process_items.label: Earn Through Referrals
process_items.copy: Share either your mint number or your link. Whenever someone mints with it, you immediately earn $5 USD. There are no limits and no expiration. If no code is provided → the $5 + tickets are awarded to a random existing ticket holder.

process_items.label: Build Up Tickets
process_items.copy: Every referral also awards you Small Block prize tickets for the current block. More referrals = more tickets = greater chances.

process_items.label: Enter the Prize Draws
process_items.copy: The remaining Small Block awards never-ending $500 prizes. Chainlink VRF selects the winners randomly and fairly.

process_items.label: Receive Your Rewards
process_items.copy: Commissions are delivered automatically on-chain. Prize winners are announced on the Winners page, notified through dashboard and email, and receive the prize directly in their wallet.

decisions.reason: The existing message-195 MODIFY already records the $5 founder share, $5 referral commission, and $5 Small Block pool allocation with Big Block removed as a destination.
Removing Big Block prizes does not change the mint-number referral identity, sharing methods, display surfaces, or resale behavior.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already narrows VRF winner selection and its scope to the remaining Small Block draw.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already records the new $5-per-mint funding allocation; the Small Block prize amount and draw rules otherwise remain unchanged.
The source retains the $5 commission and does not change its random-holder allocation when no referral code is used.
Removing Big Block prizes does not alter the established automatic direct-wallet delivery mode for remaining prizes.
Active Small Block tickets can still transfer with a resold NFT, so the generic active-ticket transfer rule remains valid unchanged.
Fiat-buyer wallets still hold NFTs, referral commissions, and remaining Small Block prizes; provisioning and access behavior are unchanged.
The source explicitly retains the affiliate share at $5 and does not change the referral commission trigger, recipient, timing, or payout destination.
The Winners page, dashboard, and email channels remain applicable to winners of the continuing Small Block prizes.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already removes the obsolete big_block_ticket_counter_visible attribute while preserving Small Block and badge metadata.
